content.overview: Section 322 formed part of the voluntary winding-up provisions (Part II of Chapter XX, sections 304–323) and has been omitted by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Voluntary winding up under the Companies Act is not current procedure. Members' or creditors' voluntary liquidation is under the IBC. Tribunal winding up remains under sections 270–303 of the Act.
content.glance: s. 322 omitted with voluntary winding-up block (304–323); use IBC for voluntary liquidation; Tribunal winding up under ss. 270–303 remains.
content.study: Section 322 has been omitted. Do not plead omitted voluntary-winding-up machinery as current Companies Act procedure. Name the IBC voluntary-liquidation route or the surviving Tribunal winding-up provisions as appropriate.

sections.heading: Omission
sections.body: Section 322 and the voluntary winding-up block (ss. 304–323) have been omitted by the IBC (w.e.f. 15-11-2016).

sections.heading: Current Law
sections.body: Voluntary liquidation of a corporate person is under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Tribunal winding up on the grounds in s. 271 continues under the Companies Act.

sections.heading: Study Note
sections.body: Do not treat omitted voluntary-winding-up sections as current procedure.

examples.title: Omitted route
examples.body: A petition relying on s. 322 as current voluntary-winding-up procedure cannot succeed; the section is omitted.

examples.title: Current forum
examples.body: Members seeking voluntary liquidation proceed under the IBC framework, not under omitted Companies Act voluntary-winding-up sections.

hypotheticals.question: Can s. 322 still be used for voluntary winding up?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Section 322 has been omitted. Use the IBC voluntary-liquidation route.

distinctions.title: Omitted voluntary winding up (s. 322) vs IBC / Tribunal winding up
distinctions.right: IBC voluntary liquidation or Tribunal winding up under ss. 270–303

misconceptions.trap: Section 322 is still available for voluntary winding up.
misconceptions.correction: Section 322 and the 304–323 block have been omitted. Use IBC or Tribunal winding up.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 322 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. State that s. 322 / voluntary block is omitted. II. Name IBC or Tribunal route. III. Conclude.
